as_told.title: German Antarctic Expedition drops swastika flags

plain: In 1938 and 1939, Nazi Germany is said to have sent an expedition to Antarctica. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels about it, calling it the German Antarctic Expedition and saying it dropped swastika flags over the ice. Michels, on another episode, says himself that the Antarctica expedition was very real. Neither gives a source. It comes up because of stories that the Nazis were after something secret in Antarctica.
